webPreflight.note: Health/accepting-turns does not expose per-review task, trace or attachment provenance.

webReviewVerify.note: Validates a supplied JSON record; it does not call the Web host or recover missing receipts.

routingTrace.note: CEOS routing-trace can ingest a real review file but cannot manufacture taskId, reviewTraceId or attachment receipt.

availableComputerSurfaces.note: No supported host contract was exposed through these surfaces for trusted Web review receipts.

attachmentReceipt.sourceHead: required and bound to the supplied local screenshot

review.reviewerRole: required provider-attested role matching ceos_bulk_checker_web, ceos_reasoner_web or ceos_art_director_web
review.actualPixelsReceived: required true only when the host confirms receipt

minimalHostSideFix: Expose a trusted per-call response envelope or receipt store that atomically binds current sourceHead, local attachment path plus SHA-256/bytes/format/dimensions, provider taskId, reviewTraceId, attested model route and reviewer role to the returned review. Keep the existing fail-closed validators unchanged.
stopRule: Do not resend attachments or continue Web High batches until one control scene returns this complete provenance envelope for all three roles.
